entry: position == 0 and RDV[1] < et_short and volume > 0 -> SELL
exit: position == -1 and RDV[1] > 0 and volume > 0 -> BUY
entry_price_source: No price is stored; source documentation assumes Open and the string signal carries no price.
exit_price_source: No price is stored; source documentation assumes Open and the string signal carries no price.
execution_assumptions: SELL immediately sets internal position to -1
BUY immediately sets internal position to 0
